title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU-Greenland Education Partnership 2026-2027

description.narrative: This action is the last financing agreement under the current Multiannual Financial Framework (MFF) and builds on the gains of previous EU support programmes to Greenland's education sector. It integrates the lessons learnt from previous programming cycles and translates the key recommendations of the Public Expenditure Review (PER) into concrete activities and indicators.The overall objective of this support is to contributes to the sustainable development, resilience and diversification of the Greenlandic economy by supporting the development of a skilled, locally rooted workforce. The action is structured around three specific objectives. The first focuses on improving the quality of education and completion rates across all levels ¿ from early childhood care and education (ECCE) through to Vocational Education and Training (VET) and upper secondary (GUX) ¿ with particular attention to teacher workforce planning, guidance, smoother transitions, and the scaling up of distance learning as a structural response to Greenland's geographic challenges. The second objective addresses equity and inclusion, supporting student well-being, the integration of children with special needs, progress towards the meaningful incorporation of Inuit culture and Arctic perspectives into education and the upskilling and re-integration of the ¿not in education, employment or training¿ (NEET) population. The third objective targets efficiency gains through strengthened governance, improved data and monitoring systems, and sounder financial management of the education sector, drawing directly on PER recommendations.
